Package com.bupt.ta.util

Class ApplicantFieldValidation

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.util.ApplicantFieldValidation
public final class ApplicantFieldValidation extends Object
Shared validation for applicant identity fields on profile and registration forms.

Degree level is stored in English; only graduate applicants (Master / Doctoral) are allowed. Phone numbers are normalized to mainland China +86 format. Student IDs follow BUPT 10-digit rules; ID cards use 18-digit PRC resident ID checksum validation.

Thread-safe: all public methods are stateless and use immutable patterns and whitelists.

    • isValidEmailWithRealDomain

      public static boolean isValidEmailWithRealDomain(String email)
      Validates an email address with a plausible domain (e.g. bupt.edu.cn).

      Requires a dot in the domain and an ASCII TLD of at least two letters. Local part must match [a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+.

      Parameters:
      email - candidate email; null is rejected
      Returns:
      true if format and domain rules pass

    • normalizeChinaPhone

      public static String normalizeChinaPhone(String raw)
      Normalizes a mainland China mobile number to +86 plus 11 digits.

      Accepts 11-digit local form (starting with 1) or 13-digit form starting with 86. Non-digit characters in input are stripped before parsing.

      Parameters:
      raw - raw phone input; null yields null
      Returns:
      normalized +861XXXXXXXXXX, or null if input cannot be normalized

    • isValidChinaMobileNormalized

      public static boolean isValidChinaMobileNormalized(String phone)
      Validates a phone already normalized by normalizeChinaPhone(String).
      Parameters:
      phone - normalized phone string; null is rejected
      Returns:
      true if the value matches +861[3-9]XXXXXXXXX

    • isValidBuptTenDigitStudentId

      public static boolean isValidBuptTenDigitStudentId(String raw)
      Validates a BUPT-style 10-digit student number.

      The first four digits must be an admission year between 2000 and the current calendar year plus one.

      Parameters:
      raw - candidate student id; null is rejected
      Returns:
      true if exactly 10 digits with a plausible cohort year

    • isValidChineseResidentId18

      public static boolean isValidChineseResidentId18(String raw)
      Validates an 18-digit PRC resident ID card number.

      Checks structural regex and ISO 7064:2003 MOD 11-2 check character on the last digit.

      Parameters:
      raw - candidate ID number; null is rejected
      Returns:
      true if shape and checksum are valid (case-insensitive on trailing X)
